screen.memorypalace.empty_hint:
# Memory Palace

No note is open yet.

- Run `/palace give 欢迎` to get a note book
- Right-click with the book, or put it in a **chiseled bookshelf** and right-click that slot
- Sneak + right-click takes the book out
settings.memorypalace.recovery_removed: Recovery key removed: only the password can open encrypted notes now
crypto.memorypalace.setup_title: Set a password for encrypted notes
crypto.memorypalace.setup_message:
This password applies to all encrypted notes and must be at least %s characters.
It is never stored. If you forget it, you can only reset it with your recovery key.
crypto.memorypalace.unlock_message: Enter your password. Encrypted notes stay unlocked for this session until you are idle for a while.
crypto.memorypalace.recover_message: Enter your recovery key (case, spaces and dashes do not matter), then set a new password.
crypto.memorypalace.verify_decrypt: After decryption, "%s" will be stored as plain text on disk. Enter your password to confirm.
crypto.memorypalace.verify_change: Enter your current password before changing it.
crypto.memorypalace.verify_recovery: The old recovery key will stop working. Enter your current password.
crypto.memorypalace.verify_remove_recove: Without a recovery key, a forgotten password means the notes are lost. Enter your current password.
crypto.memorypalace.forgot: Forgot password? Reset with recovery key
crypto.memorypalace.too_short: Password must be at least %s characters
crypto.memorypalace.bad_input: Invalid input or damaged keyring file
crypto.memorypalace.error: Something went wrong, check the game log
crypto.memorypalace.recovery_message: Use it to reset your password if you forget it. It is shown only once. Anyone with it can open your encrypted notes, so keep it like a key (a password manager, or on paper somewhere safe). Copying leaves it in clipboard history.
crypto.memorypalace.recovery_skip_messag: Without it, a forgotten password means your encrypted notes can never be opened. You can create one later in settings.
message.memorypalace.decrypted: Decrypted: the note is now stored as plain text
screen.memorypalace.confirm_decrypt.mess:
This note will be sent to the server as plain text and stored on its disk, where server admins can read it:

%s
